versions.changelog: Strict read-only split. All mutation paths removed (offering to update drifted plugins, cleaning stale config entries). For mutations see the new companion skill post-update-maintenance. Fixes the HIGH severity scope-contradiction flag from the security scanner.
Fix: resolve.sh requires -r (readable) instead of -x on the target script, since clawhub install does not preserve exec bits. Without this fix the resolver returned empty on every fresh install.

Profile-aware state file (multi-profile setups no longer share state). Surface-then-persist ordering with retry cap (channel blips no longer eat the notification). Update-guard awareness — skip redundant header when an external guard already announced the bump. New scripts/resolve.sh for callers outside the skill (safe-update wrappers, cron). find-local-changelog.sh now resolves pnpm/volta/nvm/fnm installs.

Detect plugin version drift between gateway and externalized npm plugins (catches the @openclaw/whatsapp-stayed-on-old-version failure mode). Verify channel health post-restart. Surface openclaw.json rewrites and stale plugin entries. Add attended vs unattended mode guidance. New helper: check-plugin-drift.sh.
